subject: poppy
name: 虞美人
label: 杯形虞美人
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One poppy with four broad cup-like petals, round center and gently bent stem with one leaf.
Simplification requirement: ONLY four large smooth petals, ONE plain circular center with just THREE short stamens, one simple curved stem, ONE broad leaf with only a single central vein. No additional stamens, no repeated lines inside the petals, no tiny rings. Beginner child tracing. Place the complete subject inside the central 76% of the square, leaving at least 12% clear margin on all four sides. Plain pure white background. Only clean dark outlines and open white interiors.
